tasks.subject: Fix energy/recharge calculation in WorkingMemoryDisplay (#2, #12)
tasks.description: WorkingMemoryDisplay computes energyRemaining = budget - spent, ignoring recharge. Must match App.jsx's bounded calculation (budget - spent + recharged, clamped to >= 0). Also item #12: one bounded remaining-energy calculation including recharge everywhere.

tasks.subject: Fix task flow: start routes to Focus prefilled, undo correctness (#3, #8)
tasks.description: Task flow (#3, #8): startTaskStep currently only sets tool and marks first step done — must route to expanded Focus prefilled with task/step WITHOUT marking done. Undo: one confirmation, avoid duplicate wins/energy. Correct TaskInitiationSupport -> FocusLap goal/duration wiring. Observer "Starta"/"Börja med detta" should open Focus prefilled.

tasks.subject: Fix capture: pass AI capability, honest copy, Enter=primary (#4, #9)
tasks.description: Capture (#4, #9): CaptureSheet promises "agenten sorterar" without consent; autoCapture lands as idea when classify off but the primary button copy misrepresents availability. Pass AI/classifier capability into CaptureSheet explicitly. Explicit Uppgift/Ide/Inkop always work. Failure saves raw idea and explains destination. Enter matches primary action. Capture never appears to require AI.

tasks.subject: Fix tools: accurate suggestions, reveal count, hidden tools (#5)
tasks.description: Tools (#5): deterministic contextual suggestions/reasons, accurate reveal count, hidden tools (visibleTools===false) never suggested. Observer disabled shows complete enabled set. Selected semantics/panel headings. Preserve dismissals.

tasks.subject: Consolidate settings: single home, connections, persistence status (#6, #10)
tasks.description: Settings (#6, #10): single home for preferences, tool personalization, agents, AI consent, connections and data. Account menu Settings + logout. Preserve OAuth. Settings state uses existing persistence; closing restores focus to account trigger. Show saving/saved/failed locally. Progressively disclose advanced controls. tablist/tab/tabpanel semantics. Connect is currently in Tools — move/consolidate into Settings (Kopplingar).

tasks.subject: Fix wind-down control: keyboard-operable, routes to tools+sleep (#7)
tasks.description: Wind-down (#7): control semantic/keyboard-operable and routes to view=tools + tool=sleep. Currently WorkingMemoryDisplay onWinddownClick only does setTool("sleep") without setView("tools"). Make it a real button with proper role/label that navigates to tools view with sleep tool.

tasks.subject: Fix first-use setup: skippable tour, no redundant checkin (#1)
tasks.description: Setup (#1): optional starter/tour can be skipped; preserve wake/energy and persistence; do not immediately open redundant DailyCheckin. Inspect showSetup/showCheckin/handleSetupComplete. The tour step should be skippable. After setup completes, don't immediately open DailyCheckin (redundant since setup just captured energy).

tasks.subject: Coordinate feedback: no overlap, one completion message (#11)
tasks.description: Feedback (#11): coordinate SystemStatus, AgentProgress, toast, undo and modals: no overlap/background focus leakage; errors remain; one completion message. Currently toast, undo, AgentProgress all stack at bottom. One completion message per action.

tasks.subject: Accessible primary nav: aria-current, targets, focus (#13)
tasks.description: Nav a11y (#13): named nav, one aria-current page, capture as action, >=44px targets, visible focus, focus restoration, reduced motion. Nav buttons need aria-current, nav element needs aria-label. Capture is an action button. Ensure min target sizes.

tasks.subject: Accessible feedback: status vs alert semantics (#14)
tasks.description: Feedback a11y (#14): status vs alert semantics (aria-live polite for status, assertive role=alert for errors), semantic retry buttons, color-independent text, avoid repeated announcements; routine status quiet. Toast should be role=status aria-live=polite; errors role=alert.

tasks.subject: Responsive setup/settings: 320px, proper tablist semantics (#15)
tasks.description: Responsive (#15): setup/settings support 320px/zoom: wrap or stack controls, proper tablist/tab/tabpanel semantics with aria-selected/aria-controls/role, labels, optional advanced setup fields disclosed. Make settings tabs proper tablist.

tasks.subject: Ideas list fallback: accessible default, graph cannot block list (#16)
tasks.description: Ideas (#16): list default/full accessible path; list/map controls expose selection (aria-pressed); no graph-only actions; preserve lazy load; graph failure cannot block list. Ensure list is default mode. Graph is pointer-centric — ensure list mode is the accessible path and works without graph.

tasks.subject: Add regression tests, run full build/test suite
tasks.description: Add regression tests (.test.jsx for vitest) for the key fixed behaviors: energy recharge calc, capture respects AI capability, tools hide correctly, focus prefill on task start. Run npm test, npm run test:ui, npm run build. Report results.
